# POA&Ms

## Business Rules
**Automatically Generated IDs**  
The POA&M Item ID and Milestone ID are automatically generated by eMASS after a POA&M item is successfully imported. These fields are read-only and do not require any user action.

**System-Level POA&M Items**  
For  system-level POA&M items, leave the Controls / Assessment Procedures field blank.

**Control/Assessment Procedure-Level POA&M Items**  
To import a control/assessment procedure-level POA&M item, enter the appropriate Control / Assessment Procedure Acronym(s) (e.g., `AC-3`) in the **Controls / Assessment Procedures field.

**Multiple Control/Assessment Procedure Associations**  
When listing multiple Control/Assessment Procedure Associations for a specific POA&M item, separate each association using a semicolon (`;`).

**Office/Organization Field Format**  
At a minimum, the Office/Organization must be defined for each POA&M item. If multiple fields are entered, separate each field with a comma. 

**Security Checks**  
The Security Checks field (optional) can include:

* DISA Security Technical Implementation Guide (STIG) rules (e.g., `SV-40098r2_rule`)
* USCYBERCOM IAVM IDs
* ACAS Plugin IDs

**Multiple Security Checks**  
When listing multiple security checks for a specific POA&M item, separate each security check using a semicolon (`;`).

**Multiple Milestones**    
If a POA&M item has multiple milestones, each milestone must be entered on a separate row in the Milestone w/Completion Date field.

**Milestone Changes**  
If a POA&M item has multiple milestone changes, each milestone change must be entered chronologically in separate rows within the Milestone Changes field.

**Milestone Scheduled Completion Date Validation**  

* For unapproved POA&M items, the Milestone Scheduled Completion Date cannot exceed the overall Scheduled Completion Date.
* For POA&M items that have a Review Status of "Approved", a milestone's scheduled completion date can extend beyond the overall scheduled completion date to create a pending extension date.

**Adding New Milestones**  
To add a new milestone to an existing POA&M item:

* Use the "./emu upload poams milestones" feature
* Leave the Milestone ID field blank, as eMASS will automatically generate it upon import.

**Date Formats in Text Fields**  
For POA&M items with a status of Completed or Risk Accepted, dates in the Milestones w/Completion Dates and Milestone Changes fields must be entered after any text.

**Raw Severity**  
The Raw Severity field represents the initial severity of the vulnerability before mitigations are applied. Typically, this is determined by reviewing DISA guides, checklists, or vulnerability scan engines.

**Valid Values for Severity and Risk Fields**  
The valid values for the optional fields Raw Severity, Severity, Relevance of Threat, Likelihood, Impact, and Residual Risk Level are:

* Very Low
* Low
* Moderate
* High
* Very High

**Impact and Residual Risk Level**  
The values for Impact and Residual Risk Level should be reflective of the DoD-defined risk calculation matrices as described in Tables 8 and 9 on the RMF Knowledge Service.

**Required Fields for Ongoing POA&M Items**  
For Ongoing POA&M items, the following fields are required:

* Status
* Scheduled Completion Date
* Office/Organization
* Vulnerability Description
* Identification source

Additionally, for Completed and Risk Accepted POA&M items, the Comments field is also required.

**Updating Existing POA&M Items**  
When updating an existing POA&M item or milestone, ensure that the changes are applied to the latest version of the POA&M item. Export the latest copy via the POA&M Export page in eMASS before making any updates or use "./emu poams get -poam-id" to get the POA&M details.

**Multiple Inputs for Costs/Financial Fields**  
For the optional financial fields (such as Cost Code and Non-Funding Obstacles), when entering multiple inputs, separate each value with a semicolon (`;`).

## Get a POA&M
```bash
emu get poam \
  -poam-id 10100291212862
```

## Get all POA&Ms
```bash
emu get poam
```

## Upload a POA&M
```bash
emu upload poam \
  -external-uid "Test External Id" \
  -control-acronym "AC-1" \
  -assessment-procedure "AC-1.6" \
  -severity "Low" \
  -status "Ongoing" \
  -scheduled-completion-date "2025-09-20" \
  -poc-organization "Test Organization" \
  -poc-lastname "Doe" \
  -poc-firstname "John" \
  -poc-email "john.doe.ctr@mail.mil" \
  -poc-phonenumber "555-555-5555" \
  -description "Test Vulnerability Description" \
  -mitigations "Mitigation text." \
  -comments "Comments text." \
  -resources "Resources text." \
  -identification-source "Access Control" \
  -security-checks "SV-12345_r1234,SV-12346_r1234" \
  -recommendations "Test Recommendations" \
  -relevance-of-threat "High" \
  -likelihood "Moderate" \
  -impact "High" \
  -impact-description "Impact Description text" \
  -residual-risk-level "Moderate" \
  -milestone-description "First milestone description." \
  -milestone-scheduled-completion-date "2025-01-20" \
  -milestone-status "Open"
```

## Update a POA&M
```bash
emu update poam \
  -poam-id $1 \
  -external-uid "Test External Id" \
  -control-acronym "AC-1" \
  -assessment-procedure "AC-1.6" \
  -severity "Low" \
  -status "Completed" \
  -scheduled-completion-date "2026-09-20" \
  -poc-organization "AI2C" \
  -poc-lastname "Fernandez" \
  -poc-firstname "Vic" \
  -poc-email "victor.fernandez19.mil@army.mil" \
  -poc-phonenumber "555-555-5555" \
  -description "Test Vulnerability description" \
  -mitigations "Mitigation text" \
  -comments "Comments text" \
  -resources "Resources text" \
  -identification-source "Access Control" \
  -security-checks "SV-12345_r1234,SV-12346_r1234" \
  -recommendations "Test recommendations" \
  -relevance-of-threat "High" \
  -likelihood "Moderate" \
  -impact "High" \
  -impact-description "Impact description text" \
  -residual-risk-level "Moderate" \
  -milestone-description "First milestone description." \
  -milestone-scheduled-completion-date "2026-03-20" \
  -milestone-status "Completed" \
  -milestone-is-active False
```

## Delete a POA&M
```bash
emu delete poam \
  -poam-id 10100291207467
```

## Milestones

### Get a Milestone
```bash
emu get milestone \
  -poam-id 74 \
  -milestone-id 89
```

### Get all Milestones 
```bash
emu get milestone \
  -poam-id 74
```

### Upload a Milestone
```bash
emu upload milestone \
  -poam-id 74 \
  -description "Test" \
  -scheduled-completion-date "2024-10-01"
```

### Update a Milestone
```bash
emu update milestone \
  -poam-id 74 \
  -milestone-id 20268 \
  -description "Test" \
  -scheduled-completion-date "2024-10-01"
```

### Delete a Milestone  
```bash
emu delete milestone \
  -poam-id 74 -milestone-id 20268
```
